title: Hydration Physiology Simulator
description: A face model sits on a table alongside a water bottle. The user tilts the bottle to pour water into the face's mouth, triggering facial blend shape reactions (swallowing, satisfaction, discomfort from over-hydration). A hydration meter tracks fluid conservation — water poured must equal water consumed plus spillage, with full undo/redo support for each pour action.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) implementing a hydration physiology simulator. Load WaterBottle.glb and facecap.glb using GLTFLoader. Position the face model center-right facing the camera, and the water bottle to the left, slightly elevated on an invisible shelf. Use OrbitControls for camera (initial position: x=0, y=1.5, z=3, looking at origin). Add a directional light (intensity 2, from upper-left), ambient light (0.4), and a subtle ground plane with shadow receiving.

Core simulation: The bottle holds exactly 1000ml (conservation law). A draggable rotation handle lets the user click-drag the bottle to tilt it (constrained 0-150 degrees around its base pivot). When tilt exceeds 45 degrees, water flow begins — flow rate proportional to sin(tilt_angle). Render the pour stream as a thin animated cyan cylinder between bottle mouth and face mouth. Track three coupled variables: bottle_remaining, consumed, and spilled. If pour angle alignment is within 15 degrees of the mouth, water is consumed; otherwise it spills (particles falling downward).

Facial reactions via morph targets: At 0-300ml consumed, blend 'mouthOpen' and 'mouthSmile' morphs. At 300-700ml, neutral expression. At 700-1000ml, blend 'browInnerUp' and 'mouthFrown' showing discomfort. Smoothly interpolate all blend shapes over 0.5 seconds.

HUD overlay: Display hydration meter (vertical bar, blue fill), bottle remaining (green bar), spill counter (red text), and pour count. Implement undo/redo buttons that revert/replay individual pour actions (each pour from tilt-start to tilt-release is one action). Store action history as array of {consumed_delta, spilled_delta, angle} objects. Enforce conservation: bottle_remaining + consumed + spilled must always equal 1000ml, displayed as a verification checksum on screen. Require 10-14 distinct pour interactions to fully empty the bottle, achieved by limiting max pour duration to 2 seconds per tilt before auto-resetting the bottle upright.
